AgentCredentials.description:
Flexible credential storage for AI providers.

Credentials are stored as environment variable name -> value pairs.
The frontend determines which fields to show based on the selected model/provider.

credentials.description: Provider credentials. The frontend renders fields dynamically based on selected model.
credentials.title: API Credentials

ClaudeCodeConfig.description: Configuration for Anthropic Claude Code CLI agent.

system_prompt.description: Instructions defining how the AI agent should behave
system_prompt.title: System Prompt

message.description: The task or question to send to the agent
message.title: Message
message.ui:help: When a trigger is wired into this agent, the fired event is delivered alongside this message — write standing instructions here, not the event itself.

message_attachments.description: Files attached to this chat message (set by the chat composer, not manually).
message_attachments.title: Message Attachments

conversation_key.description: Unique key for tracking conversation history. Same key = same conversation. Channel triggers wired into the agent (Telegram, Slack, alarms) supply their chat/thread id automatically — only set this to override.
conversation_key.title: Conversation Key
conversation_key.ui:help: When set, the agent maintains separate chat histories per key value. Use references like {{nodeId.field}} to pull from upstream data. A wired channel trigger's key takes priority when it fires.

enable_prompt_builder.description: Give this agent a prompt_builder tool to propose changes to this workflow via the AI builder.
enable_prompt_builder.title: Allow Workflow Edits
enable_prompt_builder.ui:help: In the interface chat, proposals ask for your approval before the builder runs. Background runs (triggers, schedules) apply edits headlessly.

enable_email_updates.description: Give this agent an email_user tool to email you updates, questions, and links when you're away. Replying to the email talks back to the agent.
enable_email_updates.title: Allow Email Updates
enable_email_updates.ui:help: Emails come from a reply-able per-conversation address and carry a one-click unsubscribe scoped to this agent only. Capped per day and charged like the send-email node.

show_in_interface.description: Show this agent as a fullscreen chat in the Interface tab.
show_in_interface.title: Show in Interface

x-dynamic-options.custom_placeholder: Or enter a pinned model id

model.title: Model
model.x-enum-hint: LiteLLM identifier for an image-generation model. Fuzzy input is auto-resolved to the closest registered id.

openrouter_image_aspect_ratio.title: Aspect Ratio
openrouter_image_aspect_ratio.ui:help: Controls the generated image shape. Use this field instead of relying on prompt text like 'make it 16:9'.

openrouter_seed.title: Seed
openrouter_seed.ui:help: Optional integer seed for more reproducible GPT image generations when supported by the selected OpenRouter model.

gemini_reference_image_url.title: Reference Images
gemini_reference_image_url.ui:help: Optional images for the model to edit, use as style references, or build upon. Supports JPEG, PNG, WebP. Add multiple images for multi-image prompts.

imagen_negative_prompt.title: Negative Prompt
imagen_negative_prompt.ui:help: Describe what to exclude from the generated image.

imagen_guidance_scale.title: Guidance Scale
imagen_guidance_scale.ui:help: Controls how closely the image follows the prompt (0–30). Higher = more faithful to prompt.

imagen_seed.title: Seed
imagen_seed.ui:help: Seed for reproducible results. Requires 'Add Watermark' to be disabled.

imagen_person_generation.title: Person Generation
imagen_person_generation.ui:help: Controls whether people can appear in generated images. 'Allow All' blocked in some regions.

imagen_enhance_prompt.title: Enhance Prompt
imagen_enhance_prompt.ui:help: Automatically rewrites your prompt for better image quality.

kling_negative_prompt.ui:help: Content to exclude from the generated video/image (max 2500 chars).

kling_image_url.title: Image (First Frame)
kling_image_url.ui:help: Optional image to animate as the first frame (image-to-video). JPEG, PNG, or WebP.

kling_image_tail_url.title: Image (Last Frame)
kling_image_tail_url.ui:help: End-frame image for image-to-video (pro mode). Controls where the video ends.

kling_cfg_scale.title: Creativity (cfg_scale)
kling_cfg_scale.ui:help: Controls how closely the output follows the prompt. Lower = more creative.

kling_seed.title: Seed
kling_seed.ui:help: Optional seed for reproducible results. Leave empty for random.

kling_camera_type.title: Camera Movement
kling_camera_type.ui:help: Camera movement preset. 'Simple' allows manual horizontal/vertical/zoom/pan/tilt/roll.

kling_camera_horizontal.title: Camera Horizontal
kling_camera_horizontal.ui:help: Horizontal camera movement (-10 to 10). Only used when camera is 'Simple'.

kling_camera_vertical.title: Camera Vertical
kling_camera_vertical.ui:help: Vertical camera movement (-10 to 10). Only used when camera is 'Simple'.

kling_camera_zoom.title: Camera Zoom
kling_camera_zoom.ui:help: Zoom level (-10 to 10). Positive = zoom in, negative = zoom out.

kling_camera_pan.title: Camera Pan
kling_camera_pan.ui:help: Pan rotation (-10 to 10). Only used when camera is 'Simple'.

kling_camera_tilt.title: Camera Tilt
kling_camera_tilt.ui:help: Tilt rotation (-10 to 10). Only used when camera is 'Simple'.

kling_camera_roll.title: Camera Roll
kling_camera_roll.ui:help: Roll rotation (-10 to 10). Only used when camera is 'Simple'.

kling_image_count.title: Number of Images
kling_image_count.ui:help: Number of images to generate (1-9). Only applies to image generation models.
